post.description: Search medicines evaluated through EMA's centralised procedure (EU EPAR medicine pages): name, EMA product number, status (Authorised, Withdrawn, Refused, ...), INN, active substance, ATC code, therapeutic area, marketing authorisation holder, procedure dates and flags such as orphan, generic, biosimilar and conditional approval. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one ema_product_number. Therapeutic indications are withheld. Every result carries EMA attribution.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page with the same filters. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

ema_product_number.description: Exact EMA product number, e.g. EMEA/H/C/000603. No match is not_found. Pattern: ^EMEA/[HV]/C/[0-9]{6}$.

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 25; default 10.

query.description: Words that must all appear, case-insensitive, in the medicine name, product number, INN, active substance, therapeutic area, ATC code or marketing authorisation holder, e.g. natalizumab.

status.description: Exact medicine_status, case-insensitive, e.g. Authorised, Withdrawn, Refused, Lapsed, Expired, Revoked, Opinion, Application withdrawn.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search medicines evaluated through EMA's centralised procedure (EU EPAR medicine pages): name, EMA product number, status (Authorised, Withdrawn, Refused, ...), INN, active substance, ATC code, therapeutic area, marketing authorisation holder, procedure dates and flags such as orphan, generic, biosimilar and conditional approval. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one ema_product_number. Therapeutic indications are withheld. Every result carries EMA attribution.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | EMA's row for this medicine with its original keys, all strings; empty string means EMA published no value. Fields in withheld_fields are removed. |
| `ema_product_number` | string |  |
| `medicine_url` | string | EMA medicine (EPAR) page. |
| `name_of_medicine` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Search medicine supply shortages assessed by EMA: medicine, INN, status (Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved, Medicine discontinued), pharmaceutical forms and strengths affected, availability of alternatives, expected resolution and the EMA shortage page. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one record_id. Covers shortages EMA assessed, not every national shortage. Every result carries EMA attribution.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page with the same filters. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 25; default 10.

query.description: Words that must all appear, case-insensitive, in the medicine affected, INN, therapeutic area or pharmaceutical form, e.g. immunoglobulins.

record_id.description: record_id returned by this function, e.g. cerezyme. No match is not_found. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,200}$.

status.description: Exact supply_shortage_status, case-insensitive: Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved or Medicine discontinued.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search medicine supply shortages assessed by EMA: medicine, INN, status (Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved, Medicine discontinued), pharmaceutical forms and strengths affected, availability of alternatives, expected resolution and the EMA shortage page. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one record_id. Covers shortages EMA assessed, not every national shortage. Every result carries EMA attribution.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | EMA's row for this shortage with its original keys, all strings; dates are DD/MM/YYYY and an empty string means EMA published no value. |
| `medicine_affected` | string |  |
| `record_id` | string | Slug of the EMA shortage page; use with record_id to fetch this entry. |
| `shortage_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
